description: Cancels a PENDING trade offer between two users; both are told at once. A completed trade cannot be undone here: put the items back by hand (neblla_table_row for rows, neblla_credits for credits). What can be traded: neblla_update_app_games trade; neblla_trades_read lists.

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

env.description: "pro" (the published app, what users have) or "pre" (the private test copy); left out: the environment the developer picked for this app in the panel.

name: neblla_trades
title: Cancel a trade offer
